# then that many bytes of JSON) of the LOCAL copy at
# downloaded at resolve/<sha>/ and sha256-verified against the HF LFS oid. No payload
# was read for this census. Family = tensor name with layers.<N> -> layers.{L} and
# attn_res query indices -> {I}; rows split by (dtype, shape) so every row is homogeneous.
# Columns: status  family  example  shape  dtype  count  bytes-per-tensor  total-bytes.

# ---- SHARD PIN (not vendored: 19.5 GB; re-fetchable at resolve/<sha>/) -------------------
#   (both sha256s recomputed from the live local files and matched to the HF tree API LFS oids)
# ---- VENDORED BYTES (this directory and its parent; gate recomputes fnv1a64) -------------
#   small-mxfp8's chat_template / special_tokens_map / tokenizer_config are byte-identical to
#   mini's (sha256 and fnv1a64 equal); the gate asserts that identity rather than trusting it.
#   tiktoken.model is the BPE rank file (200055 lines), byte-identical between Mini and
#   Small-MXFP8 (sha256 equal); vendored ONCE at the parent level. The members' 26 MB
#   tokenizer.json files are derived fast-tokenizer serializations — NOT vendored, NOT
#   read by the runtime (the tiktoken path is, crates/artifact/src/tiktoken.rs).
